sloka: तथाहि रामो भरतेन ताम्यता प्रसाद्यमान: शिरसा महीपति: ।न चैव चक्रे गमनाय सत्त्ववान् मतिं पितुस्तद्वचने व्यवस्थित: ॥ २.१०६.३३॥
transliteration: tathāhi rāmo bharatena tāmyatā prasādyamāna: śirasā mahīpati: ।na caiva cakre gamanāya sattvavān matiṁ pitustadvacane vyavasthita: ॥ 2.106.33॥

translations.english: Thus besought and propitiated by Bharata with his head bowed low and distressed, the virtuous lord of the world, Rama, firmly established in the words of his father, resolved not to go back to Ayodhya.
